import re
# Test the actual pattern used by parse
pattern = r'([^ ]+?) *'
test_strings = [
    'hello world',
    'hello   world',
    'hello       ',
]

for s in test_strings:
    m = re.search(pattern, s)
    print(f'String: {repr(s)}')
    print(f'  Match: {m.group(0) if m else None}')
    print(f'  Group 1: {m.group(1) if m else None}')
"
